messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey all — quick heads-up about a short Summer 'Hybrid Week' pilot we're running July 6-10. For SF, LON, and NYC hubs we'll ask teams to come in Mon/Wed/Fri for collaboration days. Tues/Thurs remain WFH optional. Please read details below and RSVP via the office events page.

Priya: Quick Q — what counts as an exception? I have a teammate on parental leave that week.

Aisha (People Ops): Good Q. Exceptions: approved parental leave, medical leave, or customer travel. Team leads can request an exception for specific folks by filling the small form on the People Ops site — deadline Jun 28.

Liam (Facilities): Also note: starting Jul 1 we are switching hoteling systems. Old check-in kiosks will be turned off. Use DeskReserve for 14-day advanced reservations. Walk-ins possible but limited capacity. Shuttle changes below.

Marta: Any change to free lunch on the main collab day? The SF kitchen closures last time caused a mess.

Aisha (People Ops): Kitchen will be open Mon and Fri; Wed we'll have boxed lunches delivered (no hot line). If you have dietary restrictions, add them to the RSVP form.

Colin: Travel stipend for folks coming in from outside city — still same? I may bring a rep from our partner org.

Aisha (People Ops): Stipend remains — $40 round-trip for intracity travel or $75 if coming from outside the metro area. Partner guests require host approval and a visitor badge request to Facilities.

Liam (Facilities): Shuttle update (applies to SF hub):
```
Mon/Wed/Fri: 07:30 / 08:15 / 17:30 / 18:15
Tues/Thurs: reduced service at 08:00 / 18:00 (book via Shuttle app)
Capacity: 22 pax, first-come booking required
```
If you rely on shuttle, please book slots early.

Marta: Thx — loving the new schedule. Will there be extra desks on Wed?

Liam (Facilities): We're bringing 12 fold-out desks to the collab floor for Wed only. First-come on DeskReserve.

Priya: Is there a remote-friendly option for cross-hub demos? My team demos to LON + SF.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — reserve the 'Hybrid + AV' room in the console (it auto-provisions a Zoom link and extra mics). Use the booking tag "hybrid-demo" so our AV team can prep.

CalendarBot: Event created "Summer Hybrid Week — Jul 6-10" by Aisha. RSVP required. Link: https://intranet.redwood/office-events/1764506789

Aisha (People Ops): TL;DR: Jul 6-10 pilot, Mon/Wed/Fri in-office required for hubs, DeskReserve replaces kiosks from Jul 1, shuttle schedule updated, stipend unchanged, exceptions via form by Jun 28. Pls RSVP and ping People Ops on any special needs. :thumbsup:
